what_happened: Per project history, a drafted WECHAT sub-card was voided because its contact, version and acceptance backend were invented; the META sub-card environment was corrected.
expected: A dispatch card names only contacts, versions and systems that appear in a cited source.

root_cause.text: Draft filled required-looking fields from plausibility instead of leaving them blank.

rule: Leave a field empty and write 'unverified' when no cited source supplies it, and never fill contacts, versions or backends from memory.
